exposure: Women who had a vaginal delivery
Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. caesarean section)
Women who had a caesarean section
cohort: 5,236 Primiparous women in Sweden who gave birth in 1985-1988
finding: Late FI and AI prevalence were higher after vaginal delivery compared with caesarean section, with perineal tear significantly increasing the risk.
mod_finding: Late FI and AI prevalences were higher after VD compared with CS.
